capture_design.blind_id_assignment: Fixed opaque code per attitude, permuted independently of answer labels; stable across runs.
capture_design.direction_prompt: Nose toward/away is a static heading cue, not measured motion.
capture_design.frame_elapsed_scope: Host-side wall interval through frame_post_draw; reported as a diagnostic, not a GPU benchmark.
capture_design.hinges: Neutral for every image; roll/pitch/yaw commands are 0.0.
